name: Mintlify
description: Mintlify powers docs for 20,000+ companies, reaching 100M+ developers a year. When humans or agents need to understand your product, they start with your docs. We make sure they find the right answers. We're hiring in SF at mintlify.com/careers.

activity.title: Released Automations, rebuilt
activity.description: Mintlify redesigned Automations with pre-built workflows optimized for common documentation use cases.

activity.title: Introduced outcome-based AI pricing
activity.description: Mintlify changed AI actions to a credit-based model where users pay based on delivered results.

activity.title: Improved llms.txt generation for large docs sites
activity.description: Mintlify rebuilt llms.txt generation using hierarchical files so AI agents can access larger documentation sets without loading everything at once.

activity.title: Raised $45M Series B
activity.description: Mintlify raised a Series B led by Andreessen Horowitz and Salesforce Ventures, bringing total funding to $67M.

activity.title: Launched Mintlify Index
activity.description: Mintlify introduced an index of thousands of Mintlify-powered documentation sites designed for natural-language retrieval by coding agents.
